[P2] Keep unrelated deeper failures in the ambiguity check

If a handled top-level child context contains a step throwing `RefundError("x")`, then a later map item's step throws `PaymentError("x")`, both context checkpoints end at `StepError("x")`. After `result.throwIfError()`, this lookup discards the map item because the handled context is shallower, incorrectly naming the execution `RefundError`. Only discard a deeper candidate when a matching ancestor represents its propagated failure; unrelated candidates must participate in the ambiguity check. Add live/replay coverage for a handled context followed by a failing map.
